body: This change is either incomplete or makes many cosmetic changes that would be best proposed separately as they confuse me quite a bit.
Some questions. I could be missing something in TT spec which somehow covers the problematic cases, but please at least explain and ask review again.

So I came across this in my inbox, very belatedly, but the PR seems to have been in a lull for a bit. What is the current status? Seems there are a few comment threads that are open and unresolved, but no major blockers identified I guess? Let me know if I can help.
I did a quick editorial review. Please double check the comments throughout as some apply several times.

I would love to have a more detailed description of what we are trying to accomplish here. I don't think the resulting algorithms are very clear. Have you looked at whether it's possible to abstract certain bits?
This is indeed a whole bit more straightforward to read through.

@fred-wang @otherdaniel if you could reply to @lukewarlow's [comment above](https://github.com/whatwg/dom/pull/1268#discussion_r2392799916) that would help a lot, thanks! @smaug---- did you want to have another look at this PR as well?
